# Protein descriptors (generated by experiments/build_protein_descriptors.py)

ESM-2 (35M) embeddings of 20,431 reviewed human proteins, reduced by reduced-rank regression onto 1,880 function annotations (ec_level_2 34, go_function 841, go_component 611, location 154, pfam 240), fitted on the 19,628 proteins with a GO annotation. No symptom label enters; the directions are the same for every split.

Held-out R^2 of the weighted targets (five folds over proteins):

| ridge alpha / proteins | 0.0001 | 0.001 | 0.01 | 0.1 | 1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| full rank (480) | 0.166 | 0.167 | 0.171 | 0.153 | 0.093 |

| rank | 2 | 4 | 8 | 12 | 16 | 24 | 32 | 48 | 64 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| held-out R^2 (alpha 0.01) | 0.012 | 0.023 | 0.041 | 0.054 | 0.065 | 0.083 | 0.095 | 0.113 | 0.127 |

Chosen rank 64: the smallest reaching 95 percent of the best held-out R^2. Gene coverage: slice 2,826 of 2,848 gene nodes; full data 12,460 of 12,627 gene nodes (the rest get zeros and has_protein_descriptors 0).

ICA rotation of the same 64-dimensional subspace (for reading; the model's input layer sees the same subspace either way). Stability against other seeds, mean absolute correlation of matched components: seed 1 0.960, seed 2 0.987, seed 3 0.982, seed 4 0.981.
